name: get-file-contents
description: Gets a file's text, or lists a directory, from a GitHub repository at its default branch or a given branch, tag or commit; the README by default. The owner and repository come from github__list-my-repositories, and a pull request's changed paths from github__get-pull-request.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

path.description: The file's or directory's path from the repository's root; README.md when omitted. github__get-pull-request answers a pull request's changed paths.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the default branch.
